Great app overall

body:

What’s the point of a focus app if I cannot block SOCIAL MEDIA?
Truly gonna dowload another app, this is just ridiculous.

title: Why you should install this app right now?
body: I think you should totally check it out and install because, as a student, it’s really importante to focus when we’re studying, and ( lets be honest ) that’s pretty difficult! But with the fear of killing your little bush or tree, when I’m using it, I don’t even touch the phone! This app includes everything you would ever want for your study session: a limit of time, breaks form studying, a way of preventing you from getting distracted on your phone and a way of rally planting trees in real life ( this last thing doesn’t really have to do with studying... but it’s pretty cool! ). And also go check out SleepTown by these same amazing guys that created this life or studying changing app!
